Consider the string of characters shown below:

FWGXQMYXL

What new string would be created if every instance of X was replaced with FZ?

(Please use all uppercase letters and NO spaces.)

Here is the answer:

FWGFZQMYFZL

Notice, every X is now FZ.

Consider the string of characters shown below:

(Please use all uppercase letters and NO spaces.)

Here is the answer:

Notice, every S is now IG.

A turtle starts at the star in the middle, facing North. While dragging markers, she walks forward for a while, then turns either to her right (clockwise) or to her left (counterclockwise) by 90°. She repeats this, starting with a red marker, until she has drawn 4 segments.

The distance between adjacent dots is 1 unit.


Describe the path taken by the turtle by typing a string of characters.

  • Character F means go forward 1 unit.
  • Character + means turn right (clockwise) 90°.
  • Character - means turn left (counterclockwise) 90°.

Remember to use uppercase F and no spaces.

The path could be described as...

  • Go 2
  • Turn left
  • Go 3
  • Turn right
  • Go 2
  • Turn right
  • Go 1

So, using those characters...

FF-FFF+FF+F
